g.text: Reset during a pending write, then recovery
Measured UVM reset_mid_transfer_test, seed 7 | fifth reset scenario: waiting for the B response
W commits at 4605 ns; B has not arrived at reset.
Synchronous reset clears BUSY and pending state at 4615 ns.
Four B handshakes retire 16 bytes. DONE / IRQ rise at 5355 ns.
The independent scoreboard verifies memory retention and recovery.
Two labeled windows from one continuous trace; 360 ns omitted between panels. Each panel has its own ns scale.
